Guitarist Sheryl Bailey transitioned from heavy metal to jazz after hearing Wes Montgomery on the radio. She fashioned a career in New York, frequently collaborating with Gary Versace, Ian Froman, and Harvie S. She is on the faculty at Berklee College of Music.
Sheryl was interviewed via Zoom on July 24, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Sheryl Bailey with me today, a jazz guitarist and educator. And in an article in Vintage Guitar magazine you were described as “Guitar goddess of modern jazz.”
I hope that’s on your resume.
Yes. It’s definitely on my resume. Who wouldn’t put it on their resume?
Did you — I read you had aspirations or you were — I don’t want to overstate this, perhaps you wanted to be the guitar goddess of heavy metal?
